claims: Hydrocodone is an opioid painkiller.
Hydrocodone is often combined with acetaminophen.
Vicodin is a Hydrocodone and acetaminophen combination.
Norco is a Hydrocodone and acetaminophen combination.
Hydrocodone works by changing how the brain responds to pain.
Hydrocodone carries risks of addiction.
Hydrocodone carries risks of misuse.
Hydrocodone carries risks of fatal respiratory depression.
Hydrocodone is used to treat severe pain that cannot be managed with other non-opioid medications.
Hydrocodone is frequently combined with non-opioid pain relievers like acetaminophen to enhance pain relief.
Vicodin is a common brand name for Hydrocodone.
Norco is a common brand name for Hydrocodone.
Lortab is a common brand name for Hydrocodone.
Lorcet is a common brand name for Hydrocodone.
Hycodan is a common brand name for Hydrocodone.
Vicoprofen is a common brand name for Hydrocodone.
Dizziness or lightheadedness is a common side effect of Hydrocodone.
Constipation is a common side effect of Hydrocodone.
Nausea and vomiting is a common side effect of Hydrocodone.
Drowsiness is a common side effect of Hydrocodone.
Dry mouth is a common side effect of Hydrocodone.
Headache is a common side effect of Hydrocodone.
Hydrocodone overdose can be fatal.
Slowed or stopped breathing is a symptom of Hydrocodone overdose.
Extreme drowsiness or sluggishness is a symptom of Hydrocodone overdose.
Loss of muscle tone is a symptom of Hydrocodone overdose.
Cold clammy skin is a symptom of Hydrocodone overdose.
Pinpoint pupils is a symptom of Hydrocodone overdose.
Coma is a symptom of Hydrocodone overdose.
Stopping Hydrocodone suddenly can cause severe withdrawal.
Restlessness or irritability is a symptom of Hydrocodone withdrawal.
Muscle aches and backache is a symptom of Hydrocodone withdrawal.
Joint pain is a symptom of Hydrocodone withdrawal.
Insomnia is a symptom of Hydrocodone withdrawal.
Diarrhea vomiting or cold flashes is a symptom of Hydrocodone withdrawal.
Long-term use of Hydrocodone can lead to physical and mental dependence.
